literal: Of virtue, the path is this, saying is not needed; between the palanquin with the one who bears and the one who rides.
translation: There is no need to explain that this is the path of virtue; just look at the difference between the palanquin bearer and the rider.
modern: அறத்தின் வழி இதுதான் என்று சொல்லத் தேவையில்லை; பல்லக்கைத் தூக்குபவனுக்கும் அதில் ஏறிச் செல்பவனுக்கும் இடையே உள்ள வேறுபாட்டைப் பார்த்தாலே தெரியும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the visible consequences of virtue. The poet states that one does not need words to explain the path of virtue. The contrast between the person riding in the palanquin and the person bearing it serves as a living example. The rider enjoys the fruits of virtuous deeds, while the bearer experiences the burden of lacking them.
